description: Finds natural gas pipelines, operating power plants, battery storage facilities, and retired brownfield power plant sites near a project or location. Pass a project name, city, state, or coordinates.

action.description: Primary fuel or generation action focus (default: 'generation_and_storage').

fuel_type_filter.description: List of generation fuel types to include (e.g. ['nuclear', 'natural_gas', 'battery']).

latitude.description: Site latitude in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. 32.4487).

limit.description: Maximum number of asset records to return.

location.description: City, county, or market location (e.g. 'Abilene, TX', 'Columbus, OH').

longitude.description: Site longitude in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. -99.7331).

min_capacity_mw.description: Minimum plant generating capacity in megawatts (e.g. 50).

min_generation_mw.description: Alias for minimum plant generating capacity in megawatts (e.g. 20).

operating_only.description: When true, filter to currently operating generation plants.

project.description: Project name, alias, canonical project ID, Map project ID, queue ID, or developer plus place (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Hyperion', 'AXP-US-LA-00003', 'QTS Atlanta').

project_id.description: Optional project ID to search nearby gas pipelines and power plants (e.g. 'P017').

project_name.description: Optional project name to center the search on (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene').

query.description: Free-text query for power plants, gas pipelines, or brownfields (e.g. 'Abilene, TX').

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles around target coordinates (default: 30).

site.description: Project name, site name, city, county, or canonical ID (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Columbus, OH', 'Loudoun County, VA').

name: query_fuel_and_generation_assets

next_useful_tools.description: Suggested follow-up MCP tools relevant to this result.

status.description: Execution status (OK, SUCCESS, RESOLVED, AMBIGUOUS_ENTITY, NOT_FOUND, ERROR).

using_project.description: Banner confirming the resolved project name, city, state, and canonical ID when a project was matched.

title: Query Fuel and Generation Assets
